name: Box Drop to Single-Leg Landing
steps: Stand near the edge of a low box facing clear floor space.
Step off and land on one foot with your hip and knee bending together.
Steady yourself on the landing leg before placing the other foot down.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your landing knee aligned squarely over your middle toes rather than collapsing inward.
Start with a low box height until every landing feels quiet, soft, and balanced.
